blurb: An evening of wonder awaits at "The Magic Show," featuring Drew Thomas, a finalist from America’s Got Talent. This captivating performance combines mind-bending magic, large-scale illusions, and humor, creating an electrifying atmosphere that blurs the lines between reality and illusion. With immersive audience participation and astonishing acts, every moment is designed to engage and entertain. Limited seating ensures an exclusive experience, making it perfect for romantic dates or special celebrations. Enhance your night with a pre-show dinner at one of the MICHELIN-Recommended restaurants at Grande Lakes Orlando, ensuring a memorable evening filled with laughter and magic.
